title: Cost Registers — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: An employee's payroll cost for one month and run, split across ledger accounts and cost elements. The cost engine writes these from the payslip and the employee's wage accounts; the journal voucher is built from them.

fields.label: EmployeeId
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from the employee list.

fields.label: Period
fields.html:
What it is. The month the cost is for.

Example. 2026-04-30

fields.label: PayrollRunType
fields.rules: Required. One of: Regular, Off Cycle.
fields.html:
What it is. Whether the cost came from a regular or an off-cycle run.

Example. Regular
